title: Saxonberg Command Definition
description: YAML command spec consumed by CommandApi. Each .yaml file in this directory must validate against this schema.

verbs.description: Command verbs and aliases. The first entry is the primary verb.

controller.description: Class name of the CommandController to dispatch to.

args.description: Positional args for the (flat) verb. Mutually exclusive with `subcommands`.

subcommands.description: Subcommand-keyed dispatch map. Mutually exclusive with `args`.

name.description: Field name the bound value lands on. Reserved: `subcommand` (when the verb declares subcommands).

type.description: Field value type. `object` runs `MqlApi.resolveOne` (single-cardinality MQL); `objects` runs `MqlApi.resolveMany` (plural-cardinality MQL).

greedy.description: Greedy positional: consumes the remainder of input verbatim. Must be the last arg in its array.

multiple.description: Accumulate multiple values into an array. Used for non-MQL fields; for MQL plural use `type: objects` instead.

default.description: Fill-in text used when the player provides no input for this field. Runs through ShellApi.expandVariables — `default: "$focus"` resolves to the giver's current focus at bind time.

scope.description: MQL fragment(s) the dispatcher tries when resolving this field. Each entry runs through ShellApi.expandVariables and is tried in order; first non-empty result wins. Array form is the explicit fallback chain (e.g. `['$focus', 'inventory, here']` for drill-first). Only meaningful for `type: object` / `type: objects`.

updates_focus.description: Focus management policy. `extend` appends the input fragment to the giver's current focus with `:` (with same-anchor compaction); `replace` re-anchors wholesale; `none` (default) leaves focus alone. Inspection-shaped verbs (look, examine, open, close) declare `extend`.

prepositions.description: Optional list of leading prepositions the matcher consumes (e.g. `[at]` for `look at`, `[to]` for `give X to Y`).

field.description: Field name the bound value lands on. Defaults to the option's own name.

validatorSpec.description: Validator path. Must start with `/` (mud-rooted absolute) or `./` / `../` (relative to YAML).
